class.name: SourcePPVPK
class.brief_description: Allows reading and writing standard VPK archives through the bundled SourcePP library.

method.name: add_directory
method.description: Adds the contents of [param source_dir] to the archive under [param entry_base_dir]. Returns the number of files added, or [code]-1[/code] on failure.

method.name: add_file
method.description: Queues a file from disk to be written into the archive at [param entry_path].

method.name: add_file_from_buffer
method.description: Queues [param data] to be written into the archive at [param entry_path].

method.name: bake
method.description: Writes the queued archive state to disk. If [param output_dir] is empty, the current archive is overwritten.

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded archive.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates a new VPK archive at [param path] and opens it.

method.name: get_file_count
method.description: Returns the total number of baked and unbaked files in the archive.

method.name: get_files
method.description: Returns the archive entry paths.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the current archive path.

method.name: has_file
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param path] exists in the archive.

method.name: has_pack_checksum
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the archive format carries an overall pack checksum.

method.name: has_signature
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the archive currently has a signature block.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an archive is currently loaded.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the VPK archive at [param path].

method.name: read_file
method.description: Reads the full contents of the file at [param path].

method.name: read_file_text
method.description: Reads the file at [param path] as UTF-8 text.

method.name: remove_directory
method.description: Removes all entries under [param directory] and returns the number of removed entries.

method.name: remove_file
method.description: Removes the file at [param path] from the archive state.

method.name: verify_entry_checksums
method.description: Returns the paths of entries whose recorded checksum does not match the file contents.

method.name: verify_pack_checksum
method.description: Verifies the overall pack checksum if the current VPK format supports it.

method.name: verify_signature
method.description: Verifies the archive signature if present.

members.member: Size in bytes for generated archive chunks when baking.
The VPK version used for baking.
